assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A Notion-native project knowledge-base workflow that captures mixed notes, decisions, links, observations, structured pages, tags, summaries, and backlinks.
assessments.rationale: This defines analytics KPIs and locks metric decisions; it does not organize mixed project material into a durable Notion knowledge base.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A Notion knowledge-base capture workflow rather than live competitor research.
assessments.rationale: This performs live-web competitor intelligence and reporting, which does not address the requested durable Notion knowledge-base capture.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A Notion-native workflow for organizing mixed project material beyond resolved support-ticket articles, including tags, summaries, and backlinks.
assessments.rationale: It produces searchable knowledge-base content, but only by converting resolved support tickets into single support articles rather than organizing mixed project notes and links.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Notion-specific pages, tagging, summaries, and backlinks for mixed project material outside BI/data-estate orientation.
assessments.rationale: It maintains a durable knowledge base and records decisions, but is narrowly for orienting BI/data projects and does not provide the requested Notion organization features.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A durable Notion knowledge-base workflow; task extraction is explicitly out of scope.
assessments.rationale: This is Google Tasks management centered on to-dos and meeting action items, whereas the prompt explicitly excludes action-item extraction.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A durable Notion knowledge-base workflow that preserves mixed material without extracting meeting action items.
assessments.rationale: This extracts meeting decisions and action items, an activity expressly excluded by the prompt, and it does not build a Notion knowledge base.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A Notion knowledge-base capture workflow rather than UI-convention research.
assessments.rationale: This surveys documented UI and interaction conventions before design work; it does not capture or organize project notes in Notion.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A Notion knowledge-base capture workflow rather than dimensional-model design.
assessments.rationale: This designs logical analytical data models and model contracts, not a general project knowledge base with tagged, linked pages.
